result.finding: No explicit compliance requirements detected. This is a demo/sample veterinary clinic application (Spring PetClinic). It handles pet owner personal data (name, address, telephone) which may carry GDPR obligations if deployed in a real-world context, but no compliance documentation, encryption, audit logging, or consent management is implemented.
evidence: No COMPLIANCE.md, SECURITY.md, or privacy documentation found
No GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, or SOX references in source code or documentation
Owner entity stores PII: firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone - potential GDPR relevance
No data encryption, anonymization, or audit logging implemented
No consent management or right-to-erasure functionality
values: Potential GDPR consideration: Owner PII data (name, address, telephone) stored in MySQL
